build_gguf_model_file: build a GGUF model file from numpy tensors with key-value metadata and sharding support
create_gguf_writer_instance: create a GGUFWriter instance to write GGUF format files with configurable sharding and temp file options
add_tensor_info_and_data: add tensor info and write tensor data to a GGUF file with dtype mapping and endianness handling
add_llm_metadata_properties: add LLM model metadata properties like architecture, context length, attention heads, and rope parameters
calculate_parameter_count: calculate total, shared, and expert parameter counts from tensor metadata including LoRA and MoE support
